clue.text: Support Tory church in a rut-just the opposite!

indicators.note: the surface says the church pieces go into the rut, signalling a container
this reverses the stated containment, so the rut goes inside the Tory and church letters instead

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for Conservative, a Tory
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Tory complains that the church is stuck in a rut, or maybe the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a rut' first suggests church letters inside RUT; 'just the opposite' flips it, so RUT sits between C and CH.
explanation.definitionFit: A crutch is a prop that holds a person up, so it is a form of support.

clue.text: Demand for local business capping bargain prices

definitions.meaning: rates were the British local property tax; a call to reduce them
reduced costs

explanation.surface: Shopkeepers call for a limit on taxes and offer cheap goods.
explanation.walkthrough: Rates were the British local property tax on businesses; capping means limiting them.
explanation.definitionFit: Cut-rate goods are sold at reduced cost; reducing local taxes is what a business would ask.

clue.text: Standing even though defeated by the new candidate

definitions.meaning: on one's feet, not sitting
having lost a parliamentary seat in an election

explanation.surface: An MP still standing for office though beaten by a newcomer.
explanation.definitionFit: Unseated means both not sitting down and having lost a parliamentary place.

clue.text: The sticky residue of curdled curd

indicators.note: curdled means spoiled and broken up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Gunk left behind when milk has gone off.
explanation.definitionFit: Crud is informal for any nasty encrusted dirt or deposit.

clue.text: A worker about 25 who doesn't turn up for work

definitions.text: who doesn't turn up for work

indicators.note: about means surrounding here, so the worker's letters go round the other piece

parts.note: a worker bee is the classic crossword worker
refers to the answer at 25-across, which means enraptured

explanation.surface: Someone who works around the clock but is still marked missing.
explanation.walkthrough: '25' is a cross-reference: the answer to 25-across goes inside BEE.
explanation.definitionFit: An absentee is a person missing from a place where attendance is expected, such as the job.

clue.text: How to cool down a storm in a tea cup?

definitions.text: How to cool down a storm in a tea cup?

parts.words: How to cool down a storm in a tea cup?
parts.note: a tempest over trivia is calmed by venting anger, as hot tea cools by releasing vapour

explanation.surface: Advice on calming a fuss over nothing, or a hot cuppa.
explanation.definitionFit: To vent pent-up anger is an idiom drawn from a kettle releasing vapour pressure.

clue.text: A broken nose ages

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A broken nose makes someone look older.
explanation.definitionFit: Eons are immensely long periods of time.

clue.text: An expression of sympathy is just not good enough

definitions.meaning: what one says to commiserate
excessively poor

explanation.surface: Sympathy that falls short of the mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a word of commiseration and literally excessively poor.

clue.text: One in 15 apparently can't make up his mind

definitions.text: apparently can't make up his mind

indicators.note: in signals that the first piece goes inside the second

parts.note: refers to the answer at 15-down, a kind of gas
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An indecisive fellow among a group.
explanation.walkthrough: '15' is a cross-reference to the gas at 15-down, which holds I.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone saying this word, as in this or that, is torn between choices.

clue.text: To upset Kitty could prove a risky business

indicators.note: upset read as set upside down tells us the cat word is turned round

parts.note: kitty, like puss, is a pet name for a cat

explanation.surface: Annoying the cat might turn out to be dangerous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns PUSS round to SSUP after TO.
explanation.definitionFit: A toss-up is a matter of pure chance, like flipping a coin, hence a gamble.

clue.text: Keeping a date when one's old flame is dying

definitions.meaning: courting someone, being out on a romantic evening

definitions.text: when one's old flame is dying
definitions.meaning: a fire or light becoming extinguished

explanation.surface: Someone dating again as an old romance fades.
explanation.definitionFit: Going out means both dating someone and a fire being extinguished.

clue.text: Commercial hitch enjoyed by an executive who is going places

definitions.text: Commercial hitch enjoyed by an executive who is going places

parts.words: Commercial hitch enjoyed by an executive who is going places
parts.note: a commercial hitch read as a working journey taken by a travelling manager

explanation.surface: An ambitious manager runs into trouble at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hitch' suggests a snag, but here it means a journey, as in hitching a ride.
explanation.definitionFit: Work travel undertaken by a manager is a journey for commercial purposes.

clue.text: A pot not properly closed

parts.note: a jar is a pot or container

explanation.surface: A pot whose lid has not been put on firmly.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left ajar is slightly open, not shut fully.

clue.text: Don is affected

definitions.meaning: to don clothing is to dress in it
behaving pretentiously, feigned or assumed

explanation.surface: A man named Don is a bit of a poser.
explanation.definitionFit: Put on means both to dress in a garment and to be feigned or pretentious.

clue.text: Product from mid Jamaican estate

indicators.note: mid tells us the letters sit in the middle of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Something grown in the heart of a Caribbean plantation.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar cane is a staple crop harvested on Caribbean plantations.

clue.text: The sort of gas which makes little Ethel hesitate

indicators.note: little says the name is shortened, losing its final letters

parts.note: a woman's name, cut down
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: An anaesthetic makes a girl stammer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ether is a volatile compound once used as an anaesthetic vapour.

clue.text: Brute voiced rumour

indicators.note: voiced means spoken, so we want a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a savage beast, said aloud

explanation.surface: A bully spreads gossip.
explanation.definitionFit: Bruit is an archaic noun for a report or piece of gossip.

clue.text: Ball lightning depends on heat producing element

definitions.meaning: a glowing sphere of atmospheric electricity, read loosely as electrical flame
a domestic heater with a glowing element

explanation.surface: A weather phenomenon described as feeding on heat.
explanation.definitionFit: An electric fire is a room heater with a glowing element; ball lightning is fanciful fire made of electricity.

clue.text: Enthusiastic chap whose current conduct is positively shocking

definitions.meaning: an energetic, lively person

definitions.text: whose current conduct is positively shocking
definitions.meaning: a cable carrying electricity, liable to give a jolt

explanation.surface: A lively fellow whose present behaviour is outrageous.
explanation.definitionFit: A live wire is both an energetic person and a cable carrying electricity.

clue.text: A weak-minded type has to support Communist sedition

parts.note: a git is a British insult for a foolish person
a prop holds something up

explanation.surface: A fool backs a red revolutionary.
explanation.walkthrough: GIT is a mild British insult for a stupid person.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitprop is political propaganda, originally Soviet, stirring up revolution.

clue.text: Clean and wholesome conduct requires a fair income

definitions.meaning: living a respectable, moral life
earning an adequate salary

explanation.surface: Moral living needs adequate pay.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase covers both a respectable way of life and an adequate wage.

clue.text: In the middle of a row can be seen Doctor Wood!

indicators.note: the doctor's letters are placed inside the row word

parts.note: a tier is a row of seats
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: A doctor named Wood is spotted in the middle row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor Wood' looks like a name; 'Wood' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Timber is wood prepared for building.

clue.text: Manages to avoid artful tricks

definitions.meaning: evades, sidesteps
crafty ploys or schemes

explanation.surface: Someone escapes trouble by cunning stratagems.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for evading and a noun for crafty schemes.

clue.text: East European art swindler's confession

definitions.meaning: a religious painting from Orthodox tradition
a fraudster admitting what he does

explanation.surface: A forger of Russian paintings owns up.
explanation.definitionFit: An Orthodox religious painting is an icon, and split as I CON it is a fraudster's admission.

clue.text: Does teacher set it? Yes, as composition

indicators.note: composition means putting together, so these letters are rearranged into a new word

explanation.surface: A pupil asks whether homework has been set and is told yes, writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of prose writing is often what a schoolteacher assigns as homework.

clue.text: Enraptured on being given a mission

definitions.meaning: transported with delight, an informal sense
dispatched on an errand

explanation.surface: A missionary thrilled to receive a posting.
explanation.definitionFit: Sent means both dispatched and, informally, blissfully delighted.

clue.text: Maple is a man giving unreturnable services

definitions.meaning: the botanical genus of the sycamore tree family
a tennis player who serves balls the opponent cannot touch

explanation.surface: A tree described as a tennis player.
explanation.definitionFit: Acer is the maple genus, and also one who serves winners in tennis.

clue.text: Government levy on one form of road transport

parts.note: a tax is a levy imposed by the state
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A new duty is imposed on cabs.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab for hire is a common vehicle for getting around town.

clue.text: Batting performance which calls for music of great volume

definitions.meaning: a high tally of runs in cricket
a large orchestral composition

explanation.surface: A cricketer's innings deserves loud music.
explanation.definitionFit: A big score is a large number of runs, and also a substantial orchestral composition.

clue.text: Expensive fare, so motor around the old road

indicators.note: around shows the vehicle word surrounding the other piece

parts.note: a motor is a car
via is Latin for road, as in Roman roads

explanation.surface: Driving round on the old road to find a pricey meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sturgeon roe is a costly delicacy served as food.

clue.text: Note cursive writing is needed for an official reply

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
script is handwriting with joined letters

explanation.surface: A memo in joined-up handwriting is required for a formal response.
explanation.definitionFit: A rescript is a formal written answer, historically from an emperor or pope.

clue.text: Serious accident caused by a carpet having been raised?

definitions.meaning: a multi-vehicle crash
the nap of a carpet lifted up, read whimsically

explanation.surface: Someone trips over a raised rug and causes a crash.
explanation.definitionFit: A pile-up is a multiple vehicle collision; a carpet's pile that is up is raised.
